caption: The drawing features two metallic objects depicted in fine, grayscale pencil or ink lines on a light beige background. The upper object resembles a pair of specialized scissors or shears with ornate, rounded handles and detailed designs on the blade and pivot area. The blades are short, one with a pointed tip, and the handles have two circular finger holes. The lower object appears to be a mechanical instrument with a flat base supported by four short legs, a central raised section, and an attached horizontal lever or arm with a rounded knob or button at one end. Both objects are presented side by side within a rectangular frame, and the name “Michael Fenga” is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Candle Snuffer
